question: Love begins with four molecules shifting. Which rise, and which fall?
answer: As love begins, dopamine, noradrenaline and phenylethylamine go up while serotonin goes down. That swing of brain messengers cuts appetite and can cause insomnia.
move: Early love is a chemical swing: three messengers up, serotonin down.

web.label: Titled The chemical cocktail of love. Drag four molecules (dopamine, noradrenaline, phenylethylamine, serotonin) onto a pan, sorting each as rising or falling when love begins.

source: Geopop, “Cosa succede nel nostro cervello quando ci innamoriamo? La biochimica dell’amore” (YouTube, 2025)
